# Public handoff update — v0.1.3-r10.34

The corrected external handoff overlay is now publicly released:

- Release: https://github.com/ahvsjags/BioInterfaceOS/releases/tag/v0.1.3-r10.34
- Scientific candidate: `v0.1.3-r10.32`
- Scientific candidate manifest: `release/empirical_candidate_v0.1.3-r10.32/release_manifest.json`
- Issue for non-author coordination: https://github.com/ahvsjags/BioInterfaceOS/issues/2

This release repairs version and estimand-boundary pointers. It is an
executable coordination surface, not an external receipt. The paper-derived
route uses public full text and supplementary/accession data; it supports
auditable author-run development analysis and a no-author reproduction path,
but it does not create independent validation, external adoption, biological
replication, or DOI evidence by itself.

The four open requests remain:

1. one non-author protected lockbox evaluator;
2. one no-author accession-to-result reproduction;
3. two distinct non-author users or institutions running real tasks; and
4. one authenticated immutable archive read-back.

Templates, author-run executions, Codex/agent executions, and public issue
comments remain excluded from all external gates.
